instagram.body:
Truck Drivers Switching Trucks Mid-Route?! 🛑

One driver finishes the trip… pulls into the yard… parks the truck…
and then hops into ANOTHER truck attached to the SAME trailer. 😳🚛

Sounds normal at first… until you realize both trucks had different company names.

This is the kind of stuff that makes you question what’s REALLY happening behind the scenes in trucking. 

From e-log manipulation to sketchy operations, there are some crazy things happening out on the road that most people never hear about.

If you’ve been in trucking long enough, you’ve probably seen some wild situations too 👀

What’s the craziest thing YOU’VE seen in the trucking industry?
Drop your story below ⬇️

#trucking #truckdriver #truckers #transportation #logistics #freight #owneroperator #semitruck #cdl #trucklife #dispatching #freightbroker #transport #truckingindustry #truckinglife #diesel #freightlife #truckdrivers #trucker #fleetowner #logisticslife
Driver finishes this trip, arrives the yard, parks his truck and trailer in the yard. It's the same company. We'll use ABC Freight as an example, uh hops out of truck number 701, hops into truck number 702 and then reattaches to the same trailer and then continues on to his trip. Everything so far seems to be okay with the story except the fact that truck number one and truck number two have a different company name. Now, what's the first thing that comes to my head? Well, I guess e-logs. Somehow, they're manipulating their e-logs and they're getting away with it. So what's the craziest thing that you've seen in trucking? I'd love to hear some of your stories. Put the comments down below. I read most of them and will respond to you.
